title: K Closest Points to Origin
constraints: The returned points may be in any order.

examples.explanation: Distance of [1,3] is sqrt(10); distance of [-2,2] is sqrt(8). Closer.
Squared distances 2 and 8 are the two smallest.

solutionApproaches.title: Sort Every Point
solutionApproaches.complexity: Time O(n log n), Space O(n) with a copied input
solutionApproaches.explanation: Compute squared distances, sort ascending, and take the first k; clear and suitable when all points may be ordered.

solutionApproaches.title: Bounded Max-Heap
solutionApproaches.complexity: Time O(n log k), Space O(k)
solutionApproaches.explanation: Keep only the k closest points seen so far, ejecting the farthest candidate when the heap grows beyond k.
